descriptions.d19c_particle_random_velocity_800dcbe0: Set the vector at +12 to base + spread * (2r - 1) per component, with r from 0x80162bc8 when +108 is set or from the local LCG seed (x * 1103515245 + 12345, times 2^-32) otherwise; when normalize is set, make it unit length and scale it by base.x + spread.x; when scale is non-zero, multiply it by scale.
